Name: RandomTastes
Author: skiilaa
Description:
[center]This mod randomizes gift tastes for each savefile. It does not modify universal tastes.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
The mod is enabled for every savefile by default.
To disable/enable the randomization, edit [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/RandomTastes/saves.json.
[/code]
[img]https://i.gyazo.com/6c7c941df60e7b65ee6b9da06de8ae89.png[/img]﻿

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. The edited gift tastes are only available for the players that have the mod installed, and they aren't synced between players.
[/list]

[size=5]More...[/size]
﻿[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/moriczgergo/RandomTastes]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list][/center]
